description: Hidden targets (L3, boundary table). A dependency in an {agent=skip} section or a :::human block is withheld and listed as hidden, and the view is incomplete. A visible constraint on the hidden target is still carried, because the constraint is visible text. Naming the skipped section makes the target eligible, so the same read is complete. Completeness parts: coverage fails, resolution and budget hold.

requests.name: section Work withholds R2, lists it as hidden and carries C2
section Mail withholds a target inside :::human
sections Work and Notes named together resolve R2 and are complete
full view lists both hidden targets
